name: Benchmark_IR_Dominican_News
description: An information-retrieval benchmark built from Dominican news sources that measures models' ability to retrieve and rank relevant news articles for user queries. It evaluates ranking quality over real-world news content, including topicality and timeliness, and is intended for evaluation of IR systems in a Spanish/Caribbean news context.
reputation: A region-specific IR dataset with limited but growing use for evaluating retrieval in Spanish-language Caribbean news; not a mainstream global benchmark.
